description: Frodo Baggins inherits the One Ring and leaves the Shire under pursuit by Sauron's servants. With Aragorn, Gandalf and a newly formed Fellowship, he crosses Middle-earth until loss and the Ring's corrupting influence break the company apart.

s01e01.description: Bilbo Baggins celebrates his 111th birthday and leaves the Shire, passing his mysterious ring to Frodo. Gandalf's investigation reveals it as the One Ring, forged by Sauron, and Frodo is forced to leave Bag End with Sam before the Dark Lord's servants can find him.

s01e02.description: Frodo, Sam, Merry and Pippin flee the Black Riders and find Aragorn in Bree, while Gandalf discovers that Saruman has joined Sauron. After Frodo is wounded at Weathertop and carried to Rivendell, Elrond's council decides the Ring must be destroyed in Mordor and a Fellowship is formed to protect the Ring-bearer.

s01e03.description: The Fellowship sets out from Rivendell, but Saruman drives them from the Pass of Caradhras and forces them through Moria. In the ruined Dwarven kingdom they discover Balin's fate, fight Orcs and a cave troll, and flee a Balrog that Gandalf confronts on the Bridge of Khazad-dûm.

s01e04.description: Grieving Gandalf, the Fellowship finds refuge with Galadriel in Lothlórien before continuing down the Anduin. Boromir succumbs to the Ring's temptation, Uruk-hai attack and carry off Merry and Pippin, and Frodo chooses to continue toward Mordor with only Sam beside him.
